lines.trans: Good day, Comrade General. Everyone is on the line.

words.gloss: good health (in здравия желаю = military greeting)

lines.trans: I see everyone is here today. Alright, go ahead, report.
New difficulties have appeared. There's a candidate from the people here, Samsonov.
He threw the mayor out the window. Do you remember?
Right, I remember everything.
He is now gaining popularity. And Osipenko might lose the election.
And so?
The local people are afraid to put money into our cluster.
And Osipenko is lying at home right now. He has a sick heart.
Easy, Colonel, calm down. Zina, give me a fork.
Here you go, Comrade General. Here is your fork.
We must stop this people's candidate. Then Osipenko will win.
Wait. Are you proposing to interfere in the honest course of the election?
Yes.
Excellent, get on it! Everyone stay in touch.

words.gloss: get on it, deal with it

lines.trans: Yes, sir! Thank you, goodbye.
Good day, Comrade General.

meanings.note: выбросить в окно = to throw out the window

examples.trans: He threw the mayor out the window.

examples.trans: He threw the mayor out the window. Do you remember?

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'играть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to win', paired with 'выигрывать'.

examples.text: Паша, эти выборы ты не выиграешь.
examples.trans: Pasha, you won't win this election.

meanings.note: a high military or security-service rank

examples.trans: Put me through to the general.

examples.text: Генерал Круглов ждёт звонка. Будьте любезны.
examples.trans: General Kruglov is waiting for a call. If you'd be so kind.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
Gum? I didn't have enough money.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'кладывать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to report, brief', paired with 'доложить'.

examples.trans: The major is reporting to the general.

examples.text: Я вижу, сегодня все в сборе. Ладно, давай, докладывай.
examples.trans: I see everyone is here today. Alright, go ahead, report.

meanings.note: not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.

meanings.note: + dative of person + genitive of thing: желаю вам удачи

examples.trans: Good health to you, sir! (I wish you health!)

meanings.note: in an election or for a job

meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'явиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to appear, to show up', paired with 'появляться'.

meanings.note: still the official address in the army and police: 'товарищ генерал'

Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to calm down', paired with 'успокаиваться'.
